text.tspan: Six questions, one tool: block size = 256 − mask octet
3 · Size a subnet for H hosts
only if one contains the other:
is the small one's start inside?
Subnets → borrowed bits (2^b ≥ N). Hosts → remaining bits (2^h − 2 ≥ H). Never mix them up.
